Tooltip_S4_Computer_NotElectric:
Electricity is required to use the computer.
Please provide power by using a generator.
Tooltip_S4_PowerBar_Install:
Connect the power to the computer.
%1 is required to connect the power.
Tooltip_S4_CardReader_Install:
Install the card reader to use cards on the computer.
%1 is required for installation.
Tooltip_S4_Satellite_Install:
Connect the satellite antenna to use the internet on the computer.
A satellite antenna must be installed nearby, and an additional %1 will be consumed depending on the distance.
Tooltip_S4_Satellite_FoundTip: The satellite antenna must be installed within 40 tiles and 12 tiles in height from the computer.
Tooltip_S4_ComLockBox:
Set the password check before using the computer.
If the password is not set, the setting will not be applied.
Tooltip_S4_ComTimeBox:
Set the computer time to a 24-hour format.
Not implemented yet.
Tooltip_S4_Remove_PowerBar:
Remove the power cable connected to the computer.
Removing the power will turn off the computer, and reinstalling is required to use the computer again.
Tooltip_S4_Remove_CardReader: Remove the card reader connected to the computer.
Tooltip_S4_Remove_Satellite:
Remove the cable connected to the satellite antenna.
One less cable will be returned than the one used during installation.
Tooltip_S4_AirDrop:
Supplies dropped from HIND.
You will need a crowbar to open the supplies.
